d: Pole dance instructor Sienna is nothing short of a goddess, and she is ready to find her Zeus  when five guys move into her home, they battle it out on the pole  the fight for Sienna's heart is fierce, and one guy pulls a dramatic move.

Rebecca, a researcher, is quirky, hilarious and single after breaking up with the father of her ferrets  her quintet of men is quickly pushed far outside their comfort zones  with real love on the line, it's up to them to rise to the occasion.
Erica, a passionate 26-year-old, falls hard for her five guys  when Erica's friends meet the guys at the club, one guy confesses something so outrageous it shakes up the whole house.
